name: worktree-isolation
body:
Law (prose; assessed by review): every code change of a change-set is WORKTREE-LOCAL — made inside the project worktree `<main>/apg/.worktrees/<project>/` on the project branch. The main checkout is READ-ONLY to every agent except the two named agent carve-outs below.
Integration path (a binary act, not an agent): the binary act `apg project merge <name>` (verify gate → merge → main rebuild) is the sole integration path of a change-set into main.
The two agent carve-outs:
1. the `agent-builder`'s agent-definition and model-map writes on main — its `.opencode/agents/**` scaffold AND the repo's `opencode.json` agent→model map (see `requirements.constraint.agent-changes-always-on-main` and `requirements.requirement.agent-builder-model-map`), committed on main. These are TWO write paths under the ONE carve-out, not a third carve-out;
2. the optional per-repo `release-agent`'s release artefacts on main — a REPO-SPECIFIC write set the agent-builder derives by analysing the repo and confirms through the coordinator interview (never a fixed, spec-hardcoded path list), plus its existing push/tag carve-out (sole `ask` grant, behind the navigator's explicit-consent gate).
No code-writer agent (the core `implementer`, every `*-implementer`, every `test-implementer`) and no other agent writes the main checkout, by edit grant, fs tool, or raw git. Reading main stays allowed.
